newsitem.title: USA: Prison sentence upheld for Tammy Faye's husband.
newsitem.headline: Prison sentence upheld for Tammy Faye's husband.

text.p: The contractor who married Tammy Faye Bakker after she divorced televangelist Jim Bakker must serve 27 months in prison for bankruptcy fraud, an appeals court ruled Wednesday.

Roe Messer, whose Kansas-based construction company built the Bakkers' Heritage USA Christian Centre in South Carolina, was convicted of bankruptcy fraud after he was charged in 1995 with concealing property from creditors.
The U.S. 10th Circuit Court of Appeals in Denver rejected Messner's arguments that a federal judge in Kansas erred in several parts of his trial.

The fraud apparently did not involve Heritage USA, a Christian retreat built by Bakker before his conviction on 24 counts of mail fraud, wire fraud and conspiracy as head of the PTL Network. While Bakker was in prison, Tammy Faye Bakker divorced him and married his best friend Messner.
